name: print-social-guarantee-your-connection-robot-ad-green-3d-render
title: 'Guarantee your Connection with the World' ad with a photoreal green 3D robot head waving beside ghosted wifi icons
whatItIs: A green square ad with a photoreal 3D robot head and hand waving, glowing wifi signal icons in the corners, a ghosted repeated wordmark behind, bold white and black headline 'Guarantee your CONNECTION WITH THE WORLD not digital future', and a footer of editable-file feature icons.
whatItMeans: Futuristic and reassuring; a friendly robot personifies an abstract connectivity promise, making it feel approachable rather than technical.
techniques: Personify an abstract service (connectivity) with a friendly robot character.
Ghost the wordmark large behind the headline for texture.
Reverse a phrase out of a solid highlight box for emphasis.

vocabulary.definition: A computer-generated image designed to look like a real photograph.
Giving human or lifelike qualities to an abstract concept.
